mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are called rough endoplasmic reticulum, smooth endoplasmic reticulum and sarcoplasmic reticulum."
The three varieties are called rough endoplasmic reticulum, smooth endoplasmic reticulum and sarcoplasmic reticulum.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a complex mixture of cytoskeleton filaments, dissolved molecules, and water that fills much of the volume of a cell."
The cytosol is a complex mixture of cytoskeleton filaments, dissolved molecules, and water that fills much of the volume of a cell.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a variety of protein molecules that act as channels and pumps that move different molecules into and out of the cell."
Embedded within this membrane is a variety of protein molecules that act as channels and pumps that move different molecules into and out of the cell.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is called phospholipid (phospholipids, glycolipids, and in some cases cholesterol, lipoproteins.), and molecules of phospholipid form a 'phospholipid bilayer' (two layers of phospholipid molecules)."

The primary lipid is called phospholipid (phospholipids, glycolipids, and in some cases cholesterol, lipoproteins.), and molecules of phospholipid form a 'phospholipid bilayer' (two layers of phospholipid molecules).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the continuous assessment component of your course."
The TMA is the continuous assessment component of your course.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the component of a biological cell that creates proteins from all amino acids and RNA representing the protein."
A ribosome is the component of a biological cell that creates proteins from all amino acids and RNA representing the protein.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a specialized region within the nucleus where ribosome subunits are assembled."
The nucleolus is a specialized region within the nucleus where ribosome subunits are assembled.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a very important structure which functions to allow certain substances to enter or leave the cell."
The plasma membrane is a very important structure which functions to allow certain substances to enter or leave the cell.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the most abundant type of protein to span the lipid bilayer."
Integral proteins are the most abundant type of protein to span the lipid bilayer.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a biological membrane that separates the interior of all cells from the outside environment."
The cell membrane is a biological membrane that separates the interior of all cells from the outside environment.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are an important source of energy for cells."
Carbohydrates are an important source of energy for cells.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an organelle that is: a. present in the centre of a cell's cytoplasm b. composed of mictrotubles and important for organizing the spindle fibres c. surrounded by a membrane d. part of a chromosome 4."

A centriole is an organelle that is: a. present in the centre of a cell's cytoplasm b. composed of mictrotubles and important for organizing the spindle fibres c. surrounded by a membrane d. part of a chromosome 4.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a plant or fungal cell that has had its cell wall removed."
A protoplast is a plant or fungal cell that has had its cell wall removed.
fib: ______ are the basic structural and functional units of the organisms body.
Cells
Cells are the basic structural and functional units of the organisms body.
______ are composed of two centrioles, which separate during cell division and help in the formation of the mitotic spindle.
Centrosomes
Centrosomes are composed of two centrioles, which separate during cell division and help in the formation of the mitotic spindle.
______ is a thick liquid residing between the cell membrane holding all organelles, except for the nucleus.
cytoplasm
The cytoplasm is a thick liquid residing between the cell membrane holding all organelles, except for the nucleus.
______ are composed of only three kinds of rRNA and about fifty kinds of protein.
Prokaryotic ribosomes
Prokaryotic ribosomes are composed of only three kinds of rRNA and about fifty kinds of protein.
______ are known to spontaneously form bilayered vesicles in water, and could have preceded RNA.
Lipids
Lipids are known to spontaneously form bilayered vesicles in water, and could have preceded RNA.
______ is composed of five kinds of rRNA and about eighty kinds of proteins.
eukaryotic ribosome
A eukaryotic ribosome is composed of five kinds of rRNA and about eighty kinds of proteins.
______ is the most conspicuous organelle found in a eukaryotic cell.
cell nucleus
The cell nucleus is the most conspicuous organelle found in a eukaryotic cell.
______ are used to add amino acids during protein translation.
Transfer RNA (tRNA) molecules
Transfer RNA molecules
Transfer RNA (tRNA) molecules are used to add amino acids during protein translation.
______ is composed of microfilaments, intermediate filaments and microtubules.
eukaryotic cytoskeleton
The eukaryotic cytoskeleton is composed of microfilaments, intermediate filaments and microtubules.
______ is an elaboration of the plasma membrane; a sort of rosette of ruffled membrane intruding into the cell.
mesosome
The mesosome is an elaboration of the plasma membrane; a sort of rosette of ruffled membrane intruding into the cell.
______ is a circular DNA molecule distinct from the nuclear DNA.
mitochondrial genome
The mitochondrial genome is a circular DNA molecule distinct from the nuclear DNA.
______ is the living content of a cell that is surrounded by a plasma membrane (cell membrane).
Protoplasm
Protoplasm is the living content of a cell that is surrounded by a plasma membrane (cell membrane).
______ is a eukaryotic organelle that forms an interconnected network of tubules, vesicles, and cisternae within cells.
endoplasmic reticulum (ER)
endoplasmic reticulum
ER
The endoplasmic reticulum (ER) is a eukaryotic organelle that forms an interconnected network of tubules, vesicles, and cisternae within cells.
